mentions.name: Raspberry Pi smart home dashboard
mentions.description: A custom smart home dashboard for a Raspberry Pi 3a+ with an official touchscreen, written in Rust with Slint and rendered directly via OpenGL without any display manager or window system. It talks to Home Assistant, automatically switching to a live camera view with stats when a 3D print starts, monitoring washer/dryer status through TP-Link Tapo smart plugs, and pulling up Ring camera live feeds whenever motion is detected. The Pi 3a+ uses hardware h264 decoding for decent playback performance, making it a silent, low-power desk touchscreen that can be tweaked to display anything.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I'm writing a custom dashboard for it using Rust/Slint[1]. It directly uses opengl without any display manager/window system. It mostly talks to home assistant.
